description: This file implements a HubSpot CRM service class with methods for creating, updating, deleting, and managing meetings and contacts, including OAuth token handling and integration utilities.

classes.name: HubspotCalendarService
classes.description: A service class implementing CRM interface for HubSpot, managing meetings, contacts, OAuth tokens, and related operations.

methods.name: getHubspotMeetingBody
methods.description: Generates the HTML body content for a HubSpot meeting based on a CalendarEvent.

methods.name: ensureFieldsExistOnMeeting
methods.description: Checks and retrieves custom fields for meetings from HubSpot properties.

methods.name: getTextValueFromBookingTracking
methods.description: Retrieves tracking info for a booking based on a field value and booking UID.

methods.name: getTextValueFromBookingResponse
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a string with values from booking responses.

methods.name: getDateFieldValue
methods.description: Returns ISO string date for specific booking date fields.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Determines the value for a CRM field based on its type and source.

methods.name: generateWriteToMeetingBody
methods.description: Creates custom field data for writing into a meeting object.

methods.name: hubspotCreateMeeting
methods.description: Creates a new meeting in HubSpot with provided event data.

methods.name: hubspotAssociate
methods.description: Associates contacts with a meeting in HubSpot.

methods.name: hubspotUpdateMeeting
methods.description: Updates an existing HubSpot meeting.

methods.name: hubspotCancelMeeting
methods.description: Marks a HubSpot meeting as canceled.

methods.name: hubspotArchiveMeeting
methods.description: Archives a HubSpot meeting.

methods.name: hubspotAuth
methods.description: Handles OAuth authentication and token refresh for HubSpot API.

methods.name: handleMeetingCreation
methods.description: Coordinates creation of a meeting and its association with contacts.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Public method to create a new event in HubSpot.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Public method to update an existing event in HubSpot.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Public method to delete or archive an event in HubSpot.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Fetches contacts from HubSpot by email, with options for owner inclusion.

methods.name: createContacts
methods.description: Creates new contacts in HubSpot.

methods.name: getAppOptions
methods.description: Returns the application options/configuration.

methods.name: handleAttendeeNoShow
methods.description: Placeholder for handling attendee no-shows.

methods.name: getHubspotOwnerIdFromEmail
methods.description: Retrieves HubSpot owner ID based on email.

methods.name: setContactOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner of a contact in HubSpot.

methods.name: getContactOwnerId
methods.description: Fetches the owner ID of a contact.

methods.name: setContactOwnerIfAllowed
methods.description: Sets contact owner if permitted by options.

methods.name: getOwnerEmailFromId
methods.description: Fetches owner email by owner ID.

methods.name: shouldSkipAttendeeIfFreeEmailDomain
methods.description: Determines if an attendee's email domain should be skipped based on free email domain check.
